description: `-o --coverage` (runJest.ts L403-L421, shouldInstrument L111-L118): coverage counts the changed source (`src/changed.ts`) and the sources a changed test file imports (`src/related.ts`, through `tests/edited.test.ts`); `src/shared.ts`, which an -o-selected test loads but nobody changed, is left out, and `src/other.ts` belongs to a test -o does not run. Jest only. Read by `provino`'s `jest-coverage-changed.test.ts`.
